name: @xalians/api
description: Xalian generation engine and CRUD lambdas. Dependencies here are installed into apps/api/node_modules and shipped in the deployment zip; the AWS SDK is not among them because nodejs22.x provides @aws-sdk/* at runtime. Shared game data comes from @xalians/content at dev/test time and from a staged apps/api/dist-content/ copy inside the deployed zip (see scripts/stageApiContent.js at the repo root).
